policy.dates: typed Excel date wins; month-first CSV text only where the cell's number format is explicitly month-first; strict dd/mm/yyyy; NA/N/A/whitespace blanked in date columns only
policy.duplicates: byte-identical CSV records kept once (first); conflicting duplicates reject
policy.whitespace: edge runs containing tab/CR/LF removed; internal line-break runs -> one space; plain-space edges, whitespace-only cells and text NA outside date columns kept
policy.numbers_stored_as_dates: workbook number restored where the CSV shows its 1900 date rendering
